name: Key Bridge
description: Server-side helper for scarpet apps: copies each player's movement keys (W/A/S/D, jump, sneak, sprint) into the scoreboard objective 'keys', and pushes a new server resource pack to everyone live (/packpush <url> <sha1> [prompt], /packpop) and gives one player an upside-down camera (/flipcam start|move|stop; op level 2). No client mod needed.
